title: Flow Rate Formula
text: Use the formula for volume flow rate: $$Q=Av, $$ where $$Q$$ is the volume flow rate, $$A$$ is the cross-sectional area, and $$v$$ is the speed of the flow.

title: The Equation for Conservation of Flow Rate
text: Since the flow rate must be conserved, $$A_{1}v_{1}=A_{2}v_{2}.$$ Once you have $$A_{2},$$ use $$A=\pi{}r**2$$ and $$d=2r$$ to find the diameter.
